items.information:
**New Participants**
Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA
Step 2 - Register for the competition
Step 3 - Pay according to the procedure mentioned in the registrations&payments tab. 
**Returning participants**
Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions.
Step 2 - Register for the competition.
Step 3 - Pay according to the procedure mentioned in the registrations&payments tab.
Registration for the event will only be accepted if a person has preregistered on the WCA page AND made the payment.
For more details on the registration process please check the [registrations&payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PolyhedraOpen2018#3781-registration-payment).
For the competition Schedule please check the[ schedule tab.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PolyhedraOpen2018#3780-schedule)
**The registration is on 1st come 1st serve basis, only the 1st 125 participants will be allowed to participate **
